393	  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
394	  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"

396	}
397	
398	# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
399	collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
400	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
401	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
402	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
403	    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
404	    set_state failed; exit 3
405	  fi
406	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
407	    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
408	    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
409	    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
410	      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
411	      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
412	    else
413	      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
414	      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
415	    fi
416	    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
417	  else
418	    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
419	    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
420	  fi
421	  write_status
422	}
423	
424	log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
425	write_status
426	trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP
427	
428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
430	  local i
431	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
432	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
433	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
434	        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
435	        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
436	        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
437	        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
438	        break
439	      fi
440	    done
441	    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
442	  done
443	  return 0
444	}
445	
446	n=0
447	for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
448	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
449	  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
450	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
451	  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
452	  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
453	done
454	reap 1
455	
456	total_done=0 total_failed=0
457	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
458	if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then
459	  set_state complete; log "complete: $total_done trials"; exit 0
460	elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
461	  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
462	else
463	  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1
464	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
3	
4	Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
5	suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
6	<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
7	`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
8	
9	Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
10	the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
11	findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
12	findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
13	bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
14	the verdict and the missed labels.
15	
16	Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
17	  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
18	                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
19	                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
20	                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
21	                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
22	  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
23	                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
24	  no recall loss  every rule holds:
25	                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
26	                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
27	                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
28	An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
29	
30	Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
31	given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
32	"""
33	import argparse
34	import datetime
35	import json
36	import os
37	import random
38	import sys
39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
40	
41	
42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
44	    import subprocess
45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
46	    return json.loads(out)
47	
48	
49	def read_jsonl(path):
50	    rows = []
51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
52	        return rows
53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
54	        for line in fh:
55	            line = line.strip()
56	            if line:
57	                try:
58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
59	                except ValueError:
60	                    continue
61	    return rows
62	
63	
64	def mean(xs):
65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
67	
68	
69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
71	
72	
73	def recall_details(row):
74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
76	            return g["details"]
77	    return None
78	
79	
80	def tokens(row):
81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
82	    if not u:
83	        return None
84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
86	
87	
88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
89	    if not sorted_xs:
90	        return None
91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
92	    return sorted_xs[k]
93	
94	
95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
97	    if not deltas:
98	        return None, None
99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
100	    n = len(deltas)
101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
104	
105	
106	class Arm:
107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
108	        self.id = arm_id
109	        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
110	        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
111	        self.cited = 0
112	        self.refuted = 0
113	        self.tokens = []
114	        self.models = set()
115	        self.sources = set()
116	        self.done = 0
117	        self.errors = 0
118	        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
119	        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
120	        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
121	        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
122	
123	    def add(self, row):
124	        if row.get("status") != "completed":
125	            self.errors += 1
126	            return
127	        d = recall_details(row)
128	        if d is None:
129	            self.errors += 1
130	            return
131	        self.done += 1
132	        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
133	        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
134	        if d.get("recall") is not None:
135	            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
136	        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
137	            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
138	            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
139	        t = tokens(row)
140	        if t is not None:
141	            self.tokens.append(t)
142	        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
143	        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
144	        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
145	            if out:
146	                self.models.add(mid)
147	        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
148	        if fb:
149	            self.fallback_trials += 1
150	            for x in fb:
151	                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
152	        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
153	        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
154	            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
155	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
156	        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
157	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
158	
159	    def defect_fixtures(self):
160	        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
161	
162	    def fixture_means(self):
163	        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
164	
165	    def trial_means(self):
166	        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
167	        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
168	            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
169	                by_trial[t].append(r)
170	        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
171	
172	    def refuted_share(self):
173	        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
174	
175	
176	def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
177	    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
178	    status = {}
179	    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
180	    if os.path.isfile(sp):
181	        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
182	    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
183	    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
184	    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}
185	    arm_meta = {a["id"]: a for a in ab.get("arms") or []}
186	    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
187	    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
188	    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
189	    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
190	    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
191	    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
192	    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
193	
194	    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
195	    arms = {}
196	    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
197	        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
198	        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
199	        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
200	            continue
201	        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
202	        if m.get("dry_run"):
203	            continue
204	        manifests.append(m)
205	        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
206	        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
207	            if a not in planned_arms:
208	                planned_arms.append(a)
209	            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
210	            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
211	                arm.add(row)
212	    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
213	    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
214	    complete = state == "complete"
215	
216	    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
217	    out_lines.append("")
218	    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
219	    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
220	    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
221	    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
222	    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
223	    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
224	                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
225	                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
226	    out_lines.append("")
227	
228	    base = arms.get("baseline")
229	    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
230	    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
231	    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
232	    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
233	    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
234	
235	    def coverage_gaps(arm):
236	        gaps = []
237	        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
238	            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
239	            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
240	            if planted == 0:
241	                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
242	            if n < trials_required:
243	                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
244	        return gaps
245	
246	    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
247	              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
248	    out_lines.append(header)
249	    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
250	    details = []
251	    verdicts = {}
252	    for a in order:
253	        arm = arms[a]
254	        fm = arm.fixture_means()
255	        tm = arm.trial_means()
256	        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
257	        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
258	        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
259	        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
260	        rs = arm.refuted_share()
261	        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
262	        drop = lo = hi = None
263	        reasons = []
264	        if a == "baseline":
265	            verdict = "(reference)"
266	        else:
267	            common = sorted(set(fm) & set(base_fm))
268	            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
269	            drop = mean(deltas)
270	            lo, hi = bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, f"{suite}:{a}")
271	            if partial:
272	                reasons.append("--partial report")
273	            if not complete:
274	                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
275	            if base is None:
276	                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
277	            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
278	            if gaps:
279	                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
280	            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
281	            if len(mods) > 1:
282	                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
283	            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
284	            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
285	                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
286	            if not deltas:
287	                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")
288	            if reasons:
289	                verdict = "inconclusive"
290	            else:
291	                violated, refuted_violated = [], False
292	                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
293	                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
294	                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
295	                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
296	                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
297	                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")
298	                    refuted_violated = True
299	                if not violated:
300	                    verdict = "no recall loss"
301	                elif (not refuted_violated and drop is not None and base_spread is not None
302	                      and abs(drop) <= base_spread):
303	                    # only recall rules failed and the mean moved less than the
304	                    # baseline moves against itself: too small a change to name
305	                    verdict = "inconclusive"
306	                    reasons.append("rule violated (" + "; ".join(violated) + f") but |drop| {fmt(abs(drop))} "
307	                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
308	                else:
309	                    verdict = "recall loss"
310	                    reasons.extend(violated)
311	            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
312	                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
313	        verdicts[a] = verdict
314	        out_lines.append(
315	            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
316	            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
317	            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
318	        if arm.fallback_trials:
319	            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
320	                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
321	        if reasons:
322	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
323	        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
324	            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
325	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
326	    out_lines.append("")
327	    if details:
328	        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
329	        out_lines.extend(details)
330	        out_lines.append("")
331	    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
332	    out_lines.append("")
333	    for a in order:
334	        arm = arms[a]
335	        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
336	        if not items:
337	            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
338	            continue
339	        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
340	        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
341	        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
342	    out_lines.append("")
343	    return state, verdicts
344	
345	
346	def main():
347	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
348	    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
349	    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
350	    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
351	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
352	    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
353	    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
354	    args = ap.parse_args()
355	
356	    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
357	        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
358	    if not suites:
359	        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
360	        return 2
361	    for s in suites:
362	        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
363	            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
364	            return 2
365	        st = {}
366	        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
367	        if os.path.isfile(sp):
368	            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
369	        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
370	            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
371	                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
372	                  file=sys.stderr)
373	            return 1
374	
375	    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
376	    if args.partial:
377	        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
378	                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
379	    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
380	              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
381	              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
382	              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
383	    for s in suites:
384	        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
385	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
386	    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
387	        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
388	    print(args.out)
389	    return 0

391

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# recall-vs-defects.sh — deterministic planted-defect recall grader
     4	#
     5	# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9). Args: $1=workspace, $2=fixture id (pr-NN),
     6	# $3=review file (default review.md). Reads the HIDDEN manifest
     7	# evals/fixtures/review-prs/manifests/<id>.json (never copied into the
     8	# sandbox) and the agent's review.
     9	#
    10	# Rule (PRD FR-9 A/B protocol, no fuzzy adjudication): a defect is DETECTED
    11	# when the review contains a `path:line` (or `path:line-line`) citation whose
    12	# path ends with the defect's file (repo-relative, `head/`-prefixed, or the
    13	# bare basename) and whose line, or line range, falls within ±3 of the
    14	# manifest anchor — `anchor_line`, or any line in `anchors[]` for a defect
    15	# with more than one site.
    16	#
    17	# Parser (1.1.0, bd-ewrc): a leading `(` is not part of the path; comma
    18	# continuations (`path:776,807`, `path:10, 118-121`) and a later bare `:N` or
    19	# `head:N` / `base:N` bind to the most recent cited path. A `:N` glued to a
    20	# word or a number (`note:40`, `10:40`), or with no cited path before it,
    21	# credits nothing.
    22	#
    23	# Parser 1.1.1 (sprint-250 review run 1, n40-n42): the LOA-VERDICT trailer is
    24	# removed before citations are parsed, and a bare `:N` after a quote, bracket,
    25	# brace or `*` (JSON such as `"high":3`) credits nothing; a backtick- or
    26	# bold-wrapped path (`` `b.sh`:40 ``, `**b.sh**:40`) binds its own line; a comma
    27	# continuation or range stays on its line, and a continuation must end at a
    28	# number boundary (no dates);
    29	# a path containing `//` (a URL) is not a citation.
    30	# Run 2 (#11/#13-#15): a match inside any URL token (`scheme://...`) is not a
    31	# citation; a range dash is unspaced and every number (first, continuation,
    32	# bare) ends at a boundary (no further `-N` / `–N`: no dates); the
    33	# quote/bracket guard applies only to the fully bare `:N` (plus a closing
    34	# backtick), so `"head:40"` binds as in 1.1.0; one trailer pattern strips and
    35	# reads the LOA-VERDICT comment and never crosses another comment's bounds.
    36	# Parser 1.1.2 (the run 2 changes above, plus sprint-250 review run 3): the
    37	# URL look-back takes the text after the last whitespace — one linear split —
    38	# so a citation that opens a line never inherits the previous line's URL.
    39	# The parser runs as `python3 -I -` (audit dissent run 1, n32): a module planted
    40	# in the invoker's cwd (a forging json.py) is never imported (RG-27).
    41	#
    42	# Grader 1.2.0 (cycle-129 FR-2, SDD D-2.3): adds the refuted-share figure;
    43	# the recall rule and the pass/score contract are unchanged. A FINDING is one
    44	# distinct cited (path, line-range); it is MATCHED when it overlaps (±3) a
    45	# defect site or a manifest `fix_regions[]` entry ({file, start, end}: the
    46	# head-side lines a record fixture's fix commit touched). details gain
    47	# findings_cited, findings_refuted and refuted_share (refuted / cited; null
    48	# when nothing is cited).
    49	#
    50	# Clean fixtures (0 planted defects) measure FALSE POSITIVES: the LOA-VERDICT
    51	# trailer's critical+high counts; without a trailer, every file:line citation
    52	# counts as one.
    53	#
    54	# Output: {"pass", "score", "details":{recall, planted, detected[], missed[],
    55	#          false_positives, severity_counts, model, effort, tokens}, "grader_version"}
    56	#   pass  = every planted defect detected (defect fixture) / zero false
    57	#           positives (clean fixture); score = recall*100 or 100/0.
    58	# Exit: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 error (missing manifest / bad args)
    59	#
    60	# Tested by evals/tests/eval-recall-grader.bats.
    61	# =============================================================================
    62	set -euo pipefail
    63	
    64	workspace="${1:-}"
    65	fixture="${2:-}"
    66	review_name="${3:-review.md}"
    67	
    68	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    69	MANIFEST_DIR="${EVAL_MANIFEST_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/../fixtures/review-prs/manifests}"
    70	
    71	err() { printf '{"pass":false,"score":0,"details":{"error":%s},"grader_version":"1.2.0"}\n' "$(jq -Rn --arg m "$1" '$m')"; exit 2; }
    72	
    73	[[ -n "$workspace" && -d "$workspace" ]] || err "invalid workspace"
    74	[[ -n "$fixture" && "$fixture" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]] || err "invalid fixture id"
    75	manifest="$MANIFEST_DIR/$fixture.json"
    76	[[ -f "$manifest" ]] || err "manifest not found: $manifest"
    77	case "$review_name" in */*|..*) err "review file must be a bare name" ;; esac
    78	
    79	review="$workspace/$review_name"
    80	executor="$workspace/.eval/executor.json"
    81	
    82	if [[ ! -f "$review" ]]; then
    83	  printf '{"pass":false,"score":0,"details":{"error":"review file not found: %s","planted":%s,"detected":[],"recall":0},"grader_version":"1.2.0"}\n' \
    84	    "$review_name" "$(jq '.defects | length' "$manifest")"
    85	  exit 1
    86	fi
    87	
    88	python3 -I - "$manifest" "$review" "$executor" <<'PY'
    89	import json, re, sys
    90	manifest_path, review_path, executor_path = sys.argv[1:4]
    91	man = json.load(open(manifest_path))
    92	text = open(review_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    93	
    94	# path:line[-line] citations. Path = something with a file extension; the
    95	# optional trailing range keeps `file.py:10-14` in one token, and the comma
    96	# list after it (`:776,807`) belongs to the same path. A bare `:N` (or
    97	# `head:N` / `base:N`) not glued to a word binds to the most recent path.
    98	# a range dash is unspaced (`a.sh:12 - 40 rows` is prose, not a range) and
    99	# every number ends at a boundary: no letter or digit, and no hyphen / en dash
   100	# before another digit, after it (dates such as 2026-10-05 / 2026–10–05 never
   101	# parse; an open `:369-...` still cites 369) — sprint-250 review run 2, #13
   102	RNG = r'(\d{1,6})(?:[-–](\d{1,6}))?(?![A-Za-z0-9]|[-–]\d)'
   103	CITE = re.compile(
   104	    r'(?P<path>[A-Za-z0-9_./+()-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})[`*)]{0,3}:(?P<first>' + RNG
   105	    + r'(?:[ \t]*,[ \t]*' + RNG + r')*)'
   106	    # head:N / base:N keep the 1.1.0 boundary set ("head:40" binds); the JSON
   107	    # punctuation set, plus a CLOSING backtick (one after a token character:
   108	    # `rows`:40, `"high"`:3), guards only the fully bare :N — an opening
   109	    # backtick (`:7`, (`:212`)) still binds (RG-13) — run 2, #14
   110	    r'|(?:(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:])(?:head|base)|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:"\'{}\[\]*])(?<![A-Za-z0-9_"\'}\]]`)):(?P<bare>' + RNG + r')')
   111	ONE = re.compile(RNG)
   112	cites = []
   113	last = None
   114	# the trailer is machine output (its counts are read below), never a citation.
   115	# One pattern strips and reads it (tolerant whitespace, line breaks); the body
   116	# may not contain another comment's `<!--` or `-->`, so an unterminated
   117	# `<!-- LOA-VERDICT` strips nothing — sprint-250 review run 2, #15
   118	TRAILER = re.compile(r'<!--\s*LOA-VERDICT\s*(\{(?:(?!<!--|-->).)*\})\s*-->', re.S)
   119	body = TRAILER.sub('', text)
   120	URL = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://|^//')
   121	for m in CITE.finditer(body):
   122	    if m.group("path") is not None:
   123	        # a URL (https://h/x.js:8080, //host.com:8080) is not a path, nor is a
   124	        # partial match that starts later inside the URL token
   125	        # (https://u@h.com/x.js:8080 matches `h.com/x.js`) — run 2, #11
   126	        # the token so far is the window's text after its last whitespace —
   127	        # one linear split ("" when the window ends in whitespace); `\S*$`
   128	        # also matched before a final newline, so a line-leading citation
   129	        # inherited the previous line's URL, and was O(k^2) — run 3
   130	        tok = re.split(r'\s', body[max(0, m.start() - 4096):m.start()])[-1] + m.group("path")
   131	        if "//" in m.group("path") or URL.search(tok):
   132	            continue
   133	        p = m.group("path").lstrip("(")
   134	        if p.startswith("./"):
   135	            p = p[2:]
   136	        last, spans = p, m.group("first")
   137	    elif last is not None:
   138	        p, spans = last, m.group("bare")
   139	    else:
   140	        continue
   141	    for r in ONE.finditer(spans):
   142	        a = int(r.group(1)); b = int(r.group(2)) if r.group(2) else a
   143	        if b < a:
   144	            a, b = b, a
   145	        cites.append((p, a, b))
   146	
   147	def path_matches(cited, defect_file):
   148	    cited = cited.split("head/", 1)[1] if cited.startswith("head/") else cited
   149	    cited = cited.split("base/", 1)[1] if cited.startswith("base/") else cited
   150	    if cited == defect_file or defect_file.endswith("/" + cited):
   151	        return True
   152	    return cited == defect_file.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
   153	
   154	detected, missed = [], []
   155	for d in man.get("defects", []):
   156	    sites = d.get("anchors") or [d["anchor_line"]]
   157	    hit = any(path_matches(p, d["file"]) and not (b < s - 3 or a > s + 3)
   158	              for p, a, b in cites for s in sites)
   159	    (detected if hit else missed).append(d["id"])
   160	
   161	planted = len(man.get("defects", []))
   162	recall = round(len(detected) / planted, 4) if planted else None
   163	
   164	# refuted share (1.2.0): distinct cited findings that touch no defect site and
   165	# no fix region. Regions are (file, lo, hi) on head/ line numbers, widened ±3.
   166	regions = []
   167	for d in man.get("defects", []):
   168	    for s in (d.get("anchors") or [d["anchor_line"]]):
   169	        regions.append((d["file"], s - 3, s + 3))
   170	for fr in man.get("fix_regions", []) or []:
   171	    try:
   172	        regions.append((fr["file"], int(fr["start"]) - 3, int(fr["end"]) + 3))
   173	    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
   174	        continue
   175	findings = sorted(set(cites))
   176	refuted = [c for c in findings
   177	           if not any(path_matches(c[0], f) and not (c[2] < lo or c[1] > hi) for f, lo, hi in regions)]
   178	refuted_share = round(len(refuted) / len(findings), 4) if findings else None
   179	
   180	# trailer → severity counts (false positives on clean fixtures)
   181	sev = None
   182	tm = TRAILER.search(text)
   183	if tm:
   184	    try:
   185	        sev = json.loads(tm.group(1)).get("counts")
   186	    except Exception:
   187	        sev = None
   188	if isinstance(sev, dict):
   189	    fp = int(sev.get("critical", 0) or 0) + int(sev.get("high", 0) or 0)
   190	else:
   191	    fp = len({(p, a, b) for p, a, b in cites})
   192	false_positives = fp if planted == 0 else 0
   193	
   194	model = effort = None
   195	tokens = None
   196	try:
   197	    ex = json.load(open(executor_path))
   198	    model, effort = ex.get("model_id"), ex.get("effort")
   199	    u = ex.get("usage") or {}
   200	    # every token the call consumed: uncached input, cache writes, cache
   201	    # reads and output — the prompt surface is mostly CACHED input, so
   202	    # input_tokens alone (30 on a real run) would hide the very thing the
   203	    # prompt diet changes
   204	    tokens = sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
   205	                 ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
   206	except Exception:
   207	    pass
   208	
   209	if planted:
   210	    ok = len(missed) == 0
   211	    score = int(round(recall * 100))
   212	else:
   213	    ok = false_positives == 0
   214	    score = 100 if ok else 0
   215	
   216	out = {
   217	    "pass": ok,
   218	    "score": score,
   219	    "details": {
   220	        "recall": recall, "planted": planted, "detected": detected, "missed": missed,
   221	        "false_positives": false_positives, "severity_counts": sev,
   222	        "citations": len(cites), "model": model, "effort": effort, "tokens": tokens,
   223	        "findings_cited": len(findings), "findings_refuted": len(refuted),
   224	        "refuted_share": refuted_share,
   225	    },
   226	    "grader_version": "1.2.0",
   227	}
   228	print(json.dumps(out))
   229	sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
   230	PY

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats

     3	# evals/tests/run-arms.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.6 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
     4	#
     5	# run-arms.sh drives control arms over a frozen fixture batch against a
     6	# detached worktree pinned at --source-commit. The executor is the CLI stub
     7	# (no model call); the source repo is a throwaway repo (LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO)
     8	# so no worktree is ever registered in the real repository; the results and

    11	
    12	setup() {

    19	  printf '%s\n' "# Loa" "" "## Karpathy Principles" "" "k" "" "## Other" > "$SRC/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
    20	  echo "# s" > "$SRC/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md"
    21	  echo "# i" > "$SRC/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md"
    22	  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: reviewing-code" "---" "# Review" > "$SRC/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
    23	  printf '%s\n' "flatline_protocol:" "  code_review:" "    enabled: true" > "$SRC/.loa.config.yaml"
    24	  ( cd "$SRC" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q -m src )
    25	  SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse HEAD)"
    26	  export LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO="$SRC" LOA_ARMS_CACHE="$T/cache"
    27	  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub.sh"
    28	  # the stub writes a review that cites all three pr-01 defect anchors
    29	  export STUB_WRITE_1='review.md::# Review\nhead/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:210 and head/.claude/scripts/lib/invoke-diagnostics.sh:50 and head/.claude/scripts/workflow-state.sh:72 and head/.claude/scripts/workflow-state.sh:400\n'

    31	  unset STUB_FAIL_COUNTER LOA_EVAL_ARM LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES

    34	teardown() {

    40	@test "RA-1 --dry-run lists the interleaved plan and writes MANIFEST.json without a worktree or a CLI call" {

    44	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]

    46	  # trial-major, then fixture, then arm: arms alternate on consecutive lines
    47	  [ "$(grep -E '^ +[0-9]+ ' <<<"$output" | awk '{print $2}' | head -4 | tr '\n' ,)" = "baseline,no_rule_files,baseline,no_rule_files," ]
    48	  [ "$(grep -E '^ +[0-9]+ ' <<<"$output" | awk '{print $3}' | head -4 | tr '\n' ,)" = "pr-01,pr-01,pr-02,pr-02," ]
    49	  M="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-02-n2/MANIFEST.json"
    50	  [ -f "$M" ]

    53	  [ "$(jq -r '.dry_run' "$M")" = "true" ]
    54	  [ "$(jq -r '.trials_planned' "$M")" = "8" ]

    56	  jq -e '.harness_commit and .executor.cli_version and .environment.os and .environment.yq' "$M" >/dev/null
    57	  [ ! -e "$T/cache/arms-src-${SHA:0:12}" ]

    61	@test "RA-2 a stubbed batch completes: rows carry arm, trial, source_commit, model_id and seed; STATUS is complete; artifacts are kept" {

    66	  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$B/STATUS.json")" = "complete" ]

    76	    [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' <<<"$row")" = "$SHA" ]

    81	    [ "$(jq -r '.graders[] | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.findings_refuted' <<<"$row")" = "1" ]
    82	    [ -f "$B/$a/artifacts/review-pr-01/trial-1/review.md" ]
    83	  done
    84	  [ "$(jq -r '.executor.arm_evidence.rule_files' "$B/no_rule_files/results.jsonl")" = "removed: stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md" ]
    85	  # the pinned worktree is at the source commit and untouched
    86	  WT="$T/cache/arms-src-${SHA:0:12}"
    87	  [ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA" ]
    88	  [ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain)" ]

    90	  # compare.sh --ab accepts the two arms (one source, one model, distinct arm ids)
    91	  # (exit 1, not 2: the gates run; pr-01 alone has no clean task for the false-positive gate)
    92	  run "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/compare.sh" --ab --arm-a "$B/baseline" --arm-b "$B/no_rule_files" --metric recall --json
    93	  [ "$status" -ne 2 ]

    95	  [ "$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.gates[] | select(.name=="recall") | .pass')" = "true" ]
    96	}

    98	@test "RA-3 a transport failure is retried once; a second failure leaves the arm partial (exit 1, results kept)" {
    99	  echo 1 > "$T/fails"
   100	  export STUB_FAIL_COUNTER="$T/fails"
   101	  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 \
   102	    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --concurrency 1 --retry-wait 0

   111	    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --concurrency 1 --retry-wait 0

     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/arms-report.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.4 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
     4	#
     5	# report.sh --arms over a fixture results tree (the layout run-arms.sh
     6	# writes): the pre-registered verdicts, the bootstrap interval, refuted share,
     7	# missed labels, the refusal while STATUS.json is not complete and the
     8	# --partial header. Thresholds come from the real review-recall suite.

    10	
    11	setup() {

    16	  R="$T/arms"; S="$R/review-recall"; B="$S/b1"
    17	  mkdir -p "$B"
    18	  jq -n '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", batch:"b1", dry_run:false, source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457",
    19	          model_id:"claude-fable-5-1", arms:["baseline","no_companion","no_karpathy","no_rule_files"], fixtures:["pr-01","pr-02","pr-03"], trials:3}' \
    20	    > "$B/MANIFEST.json"

    22	}

    24	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }

    26	status_file() {  # status_file <state>

    28	                       source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457", model_id:"claude-fable-5-1"}' > "$S/STATUS.json"
    29	}

    32	row() {

    34	  local model="${8:-claude-fable-5-1}" src="${9:-864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457}"

    39	      executor:{model_id:$model, usage:{input_tokens:100, cache_read_input_tokens:900, output_tokens:0, cache_creation_input_tokens:0}},
    40	      graders:[{name:"recall-vs-defects.sh", details:{recall:$rc, planted:3,
    41	        detected:[], missed:($missed | split(",") | map(select(length > 0))),
    42	        findings_cited:$cited, findings_refuted:$ref}}]}' >> "$B/$arm/results.jsonl"
    43	}

    46	  local fx t

    60	  grep -E '^\| `baseline` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '(reference)'
    61	  # the interval of the drop and the missed labels are printed

+#     audit_delta_instruction: false the paragraph containing "look for what the
+#                                    review did not", else "Confirm the review's demotions
+#                                    independently", out of the sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md
+#   The appended skill prompt (.eval/skill-prompt.md) is derived from the
+#   toggled sandbox SKILL.md. executor.json records arm, arm_toggles,
+#   arm_evidence and source_commit.
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/execute-agent.bats and evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats.

@@ -123,9 +149,140 @@
 fi
 printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$WORKSPACE/CLAUDE.md"
 
-# Skill body without the YAML frontmatter → the appended system prompt.
+# --- 2b. control arm (cycle-129 FR-2) -----------------------------------------
+ARM_MODE=false
+[[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" ]] && ARM_MODE=true
+ARM="${LOA_EVAL_ARM:-baseline}"
+[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid LOA_EVAL_ARM '$ARM'" >&2; exit 2; }
+if [[ "$ARM_MODE" == "true" && -f "$PROMPT_TREE/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
+  cp "$PROMPT_TREE/.loa.config.yaml" "$WORKSPACE/.loa.config.yaml"
+fi
+
+# The arm's toggles: explicit JSON, else the suite's ab.arms[] entry.
+resolve_toggles() {
+  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES:-}" ]]; then
+    jq -ce 'if type == "object" then . else error("not an object") end' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES" 2>/dev/null \
+      || { echo "ERROR: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is not a JSON object" >&2; return 2; }
+    return 0
+  fi
+  local suite_file="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-}"
+  if [[ -z "$suite_file" ]]; then
+    local tdir; tdir="$(basename "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")")"
+    [[ -f "$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml" ]] && suite_file="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml"

+ARM_TOGGLES="$(resolve_toggles)" || exit 2
+
+# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
+# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
+_drop_md_section() {
+  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp "$eval_dir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
+  awk -v h="$heading" '
+    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
+    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+    skip { n++; next }
+    { print }

+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"

+# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
+# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
+# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
+_drop_paragraph() {
+  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
+import re, sys
+path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
+paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
+for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
+    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
+        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
+            removed = paras[i]
+            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
+            del paras[i:i + 2]
+            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
+            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
+            sys.exit(0)

+    if [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
+      echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)" >&2; return 2
+    fi
+    case "$key" in
+      companion_voice)
+        local cfg="$WORKSPACE/.loa.config.yaml"
+        [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
+        yq -i '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice = false | .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice = false' "$cfg" \
+          || { echo "ERROR: companion_voice toggle: yq failed on the sandbox config" >&2; return 2; }
+        [[ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice' "$cfg")" == "false" ]] \
+          || { echo "ERROR: companion_voice toggle did not take effect" >&2; return 2; }
+        _evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
+        ;;
+      karpathy_block)
+        local k="$WORKSPACE/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
+        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { echo "ERROR: karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md" >&2; return 2; }
+        n="$(_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles')"
+        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
+          echo "ERROR: karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed" >&2; return 2
+        fi
+        local cj="$WORKSPACE/.claude/data/constraints.json"
+        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
+          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" && mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
+        fi
+        _evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md"
+        ;;
+      rule_files)
+        local r gone=""
+        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
+          if [[ -e "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
+          [[ ! -e "$WORKSPACE/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { echo "ERROR: rule_files toggle: $r still present" >&2; return 2; }
+        done
+        _evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
+        ;;
+      audit_delta_instruction)
+        local s="$WORKSPACE/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { echo "ERROR: audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md" >&2; return 2; }
+        _drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
+          || { echo "ERROR: audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md" >&2; return 2; }
+        _evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
+        ;;
+      *) echo "ERROR: arm '$ARM' declares unknown toggle '$key'" >&2; return 2 ;;

name: review-recall
description: "cycle-124 FR-9 A/B suite: review-recall (arm A = Sprint-2 tip prompts, arm B = audited prompts; same executor model, fixed effort)"
version: 1

tasks:
  include:
    - "tasks/review-recall/**/*.yaml"
  exclude: []

defaults:
  trials: 3
  timeout:
    per_trial: 1500
    per_grader: 180
  composite_strategy: all_must_pass

# compare.sh freshness rule (evals/tests/recall-baseline-freshness.bats):
# a baseline must be captured at or after floor_commit (the Sprint-2 landing
# commit) on a prompt tree different from the one under comparison, with the
# corpus frozen.
ab:
  floor_commit: "da3bd07f3db2fc1bd09a6761a9b96b688fa2a09e"
  corpus_manifest: evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS

  # cycle-129 FR-2 control arms (SDD D-2.1). Each arm is applied by
  # execute-agent.sh (LOA_EVAL_ARM=<id>) to the SANDBOX COPY of the prompt
  # surface only, after materialisation and immediately before the executor
  # starts; the source tree is never edited. run-arms.sh drives the arms
  # against a detached worktree pinned at --source-commit.
  #   id           canonical arm id (results rows and reports key on it)
  #   description  what the arm removes, and what it does not
  #   toggles      toggle -> false; an unknown toggle fails the trial (exit 2)
  #   informational  true: the arm reports a yield figure only; its verdict
  #                can never license removing the control
  arms:
    - id: baseline
      description: "the pinned source tree's prompt surface, unchanged"
      toggles: {}
    - id: no_companion
      description: >-
        flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice set false in the sandbox
        .loa.config.yaml. The companion voice is a floor key that no profile
        can remove; this arm measures its yield only.
      informational: true
      toggles:
        companion_voice: false
    - id: no_karpathy
      description: >-
        the '## Karpathy Principles' section removed from the sandbox
        CLAUDE.loa.md (and any Karpathy row from a sandbox constraints.json).
        It removes the kernel block only, not the SURGICAL review axis in
        reviewing-code/SKILL.md or the surgical-diff hook.
      toggles:
        karpathy_block: false
    - id: no_rule_files
      description: "stash-safety.md and skill-invariants.md removed from the sandbox .claude/rules/"
      toggles:
        rule_files: false

  # Pre-registered verdict rule (PRD FR-2; report.sh --arms applies it).
  # An arm reads `no recall loss` only when every condition holds; a violated
  # condition reads `recall loss`; anything missing reads `inconclusive`.
  threshold:
    # every (fixture, arm) cell needs this many completed trials
    trials_required: 3
    # full = every fixture in the batch for every arm; a missing cell is inconclusive
    coverage_required: full
    # the upper bound of the bootstrap interval on (baseline - arm) mean
    # recall must not exceed this (= ci.regression_threshold)
    mean_recall_max_drop: 0.10
    # the arm's worst trial-mean recall may sit at most this far below the baseline's worst
    min_trial_recall_max_drop: 0.15
    # refuted share (cited findings matching no feedback label and no fix
    # region, over cited findings) may rise at most this much over the baseline
    refuted_share_max_rise: 0.10
    # percentile bootstrap of the recall delta: resample fixtures with
    # replacement `iterations` times, report the `level` two-sided interval
    bootstrap:
      method: percentile
      level: 0.90
      resample: fixtures
      iterations: 2000

ci:
  gate_type: advisory
  min_trials: 3
  regression_threshold: 0.10

--- a/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md
+++ b/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md
@@ -50,11 +50,15 @@ ## Language
 **Jack in**: To start an autonomous run under run mode; a run that has finished or been stopped for good has jacked out.
 _Aliases_: jack out
 
+**Judgment**: The task kind for work that needs reading and a decision; it ships as prose or a reviewed artifact, and its sprint task line ends with kind: judgment.
+
 **Kaironic**: Stopping at the right moment rather than after a fixed count: an iterative review loop ends when successive passes stop finding material issues.
 _Avoid_: converged
 
 **Karpathy principles**: The four working rules applied on every code-touching turn: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes and goal-driven verification.
 
+**Kind counts**: The release-notes line that counts a cycle's sprint tasks by kind (mechanical, judgment and operator), read from the tagged task lines of its sprint plan.
+
 **Known failure**: A recorded degradation with its symptom, the attempts made and a reading guide, consulted before triage so that prior dead ends are not retried.
 _Aliases_: KF
 
@@ -62,6 +66,10 @@ ## Language
 
 **Map epic**: The epic bead that parents an effort's decision tickets, paired with a map document of its destination, decisions so far, fog and exclusions; run mode never implements it.
 
+**Mechanical**: The task kind for work a script could do reliably; it ships as code with tests, and a review flags a mechanical task delivered as prose the model re-executes.
+
+**Operator**: The human who owns the project and its decisions; as a task kind, work that belongs to that human, which a review flags when it was completed unattended without a decision:unblock ticket or a DEC row.
+
 **Round**: One frontier of interview questions asked together and answered together.
 
 **Run mode**: Unattended execution of a sprint plan with a circuit breaker, wrapping implement, review and audit in a loop. Its states are running, halted and jacked out.
@@ -78,4 +86,6 @@ ## Language
 
 **Voice**: The party a decision or finding is attributed to: the operator, the agent, Flatline or dissent.
 
+**Volume ratio**: The release-notes line that sets a cycle's script lines changed against its prose bytes changed and its model calls; the model-call count is local to the host that ran the cycle.
+
 **Zone**: One of the three permission regions of a repository: the System zone holds the framework and is never edited by hand, the State zone is read and written freely, and the App zone needs confirmation before a write.

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# Path-scoped rule files (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-3.1, DEC-0129): stash-safety.md and
# skill-invariants.md carry `paths:` frontmatter, the frontmatter parses, and every glob
# matches at least one tracked file of the kind the rule is about (git pathspec glob
# semantics: `**` spans directories, `*` stays inside one).

setup() {
    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
    RULES="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/rules"
    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
}

# The YAML between the first two '---' lines (empty when the file has none).
frontmatter() { awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit } /^---$/ { if (n++) exit; next } n' "$1"; }
globs() { frontmatter "$1" | yq eval '.paths[]' -; }
tracked() { git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" ls-files -- ":(glob)$1"; }

@test "RP-1 both rule files open with frontmatter that parses and lists string globs under paths:" {
    local f n
    for f in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
        [ "$(head -1 "$RULES/$f")" = "---" ] || { echo "$f has no frontmatter"; return 1; }
        frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.' - >/dev/null || { echo "$f frontmatter does not parse"; return 1; }
        [ "$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.paths | type' -)" = "!!seq" ]
        n="$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.paths | length' -)"
        [ "$n" -ge 1 ]
        [ "$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '[.paths[] | select(type != "!!str")] | length' -)" -eq 0 ]
    done
}

@test "RP-2 the globs are the ones the SDD names" {
    [ "$(globs "$RULES/stash-safety.md" | tr '\n' ' ')" = '**/*.sh **/*.bats .claude/scripts/** .claude/hooks/** ' ]
    [ "$(globs "$RULES/skill-invariants.md" | tr '\n' ' ')" = '.claude/skills/**/SKILL.md .claude/agents/** .claude/data/agent-types.yaml .claude/scripts/validate-skill-capabilities.sh ' ]
}

@test "RP-3 every stash-safety glob matches a tracked shell source" {
    local g hits
    while IFS= read -r g; do
        hits="$(tracked "$g" | grep -E '\.(sh|bats)$' | head -1)"
        [ -n "$hits" ] || { echo "glob '$g' matches no tracked .sh/.bats file"; return 1; }
    done < <(globs "$RULES/stash-safety.md")
}

@test "RP-4 every skill-invariants glob matches a tracked skill, agent definition or capability file" {
    local g hits
    while IFS= read -r g; do
        hits="$(tracked "$g" | grep -E '(^\.claude/skills/[^/]+/SKILL\.md$|^\.claude/agents/[^/]+\.md$|^\.claude/data/agent-types\.yaml$|^\.claude/scripts/validate-skill-capabilities\.sh$)' | head -1)"
        [ -n "$hits" ] || { echo "glob '$g' matches no tracked file of the intended kind"; return 1; }
    done < <(globs "$RULES/skill-invariants.md")
}

@test "RP-5 path-scoping removed no rule text: the body after the frontmatter keeps its heading and sections" {
    local body
    body="$(awk '/^---$/ && c < 2 { c++; next } c >= 2' "$RULES/stash-safety.md")"
    [[ "$body" == *"# Git Stash Safety"* && "$body" == *"## Judgment rules the fence cannot express"* ]]
    body="$(awk '/^---$/ && c < 2 { c++; next } c >= 2' "$RULES/skill-invariants.md")"
    [[ "$body" == *"# Skill Frontmatter Invariants"* && "$body" == *"## The invariant"* ]]
}

@test "RP-6 the rule-lifecycle validator accepts both files (origin, version, enacted_by)" {
    run "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-rule-lifecycle.sh" --json
    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# tools/cycle-ratio.sh: the two release-notes lines of a cycle, task-kind
# counts and the volume ratio (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
#
#   kinds: mechanical N · judgment N · operator N
#   volume: script lines changed N (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed N (*.md) · model calls N (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: <path>
#
# Mapping (the glossary's "Kind counts" and "Volume ratio" entries):
#   kinds          the 'kind: <value>' token that ends each top-level '- [ ]' /
#                  '- [x]' task line under '### Technical Tasks', and each
#                  '- [ ] Task ...' line under a '### Task N.E2E' heading, inside
#                  a '## Sprint N' block of the sprint plan (fenced code skipped,
#                  the same scope validate-artifact.sh --type sprint enforces);
#                  untagged task lines are counted in --json and WARNed
#   script lines   added + deleted lines of *.sh *.py *.ts *.js files between
#                  the two commits (git diff --numstat, renames detected,
#                  binary files skipped)
#   prose bytes    bytes of the added and removed *.md lines between the two
#                  commits, newline included, diff markers excluded
#   model calls    MODELINV rows (primitive_id MODELINV) in the MODELINV log
#                  whose ts_utc lies between the two commits' committer
#                  timestamps, both ends included. The log is host-local, so
#                  the count covers only the calls made on this host: "scope:
#                  host". A missing log prints "model calls n/a" and a WARN.
#
# Git runs in the current directory's repository; --sprint-plan and --modelinv
# default to paths under its top level.
#
# Usage:
#   tools/cycle-ratio.sh --from SHA --to SHA [--sprint-plan PATH]
#                        [--modelinv PATH] [--json]
#
#   --sprint-plan PATH  default grimoires/loa/sprint.md
#   --modelinv PATH     default .run/model-invoke.jsonl
#   --json              one JSON object instead of the two lines
#
# Exit 2 also covers: not a git repository, an unreadable sprint plan, jq missing.
# Exit codes: 0 printed · 2 usage or unreadable input · 3 a SHA names no commit
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
die() { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
FENCE_AWK="$SCRIPT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/md-fence.awk"

FROM=""
TO=""
PLAN=""
MODELINV=""
JSON=0
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --from|--to|--sprint-plan|--modelinv)
      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $1 needs a value" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
      case "$1" in
        --from) FROM="$2" ;;
        --to) TO="$2" ;;
        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
      esac
      shift 2 ;;
    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "cycle-ratio.sh: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 2 "jq is required"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "not inside a git repository"
[[ -n "$PLAN" ]] || PLAN="$TOP/grimoires/loa/sprint.md"
[[ -n "$MODELINV" ]] || MODELINV="$TOP/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"
[[ -r "$PLAN" && -f "$PLAN" ]] || die 2 "sprint plan not readable: $PLAN"
[[ -r "$FENCE_AWK" ]] || die 2 "cannot read $FENCE_AWK (reinstall the framework scripts)"

# A leading '-' would reach git as an option; a SHA never starts with one.
case "$FROM" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM" ;; esac
case "$TO" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $TO" ;; esac
FROM_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${FROM}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM"
TO_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${TO}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $TO"

# --- kinds -------------------------------------------------------------------
kinds="$(awk "$(cat "$FENCE_AWK")"'
  md_fence($0) { next }

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# Path-scoped rule files (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-3.1, DEC-0129): stash-safety.md and
# skill-invariants.md carry `paths:` frontmatter, the frontmatter parses, and every glob
# matches at least one tracked file of the kind the rule is about (git pathspec glob
# semantics: `**` spans directories, `*` stays inside one).

setup() {
    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
    RULES="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/rules"
    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
}

# The YAML between the first two '---' lines (empty when the file has none).
frontmatter() { awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit } /^---$/ { if (n++) exit; next } n' "$1"; }
globs() { frontmatter "$1" | yq eval '.paths[]' -; }
tracked() { git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" ls-files -- ":(glob)$1"; }

@test "RP-1 both rule files open with frontmatter that parses and lists string globs under paths:" {
    local f n
    for f in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
        [ "$(head -1 "$RULES/$f")" = "---" ] || { echo "$f has no frontmatter"; return 1; }
        frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.' - >/dev/null || { echo "$f frontmatter does not parse"; return 1; }
        [ "$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.paths | type' -)" = "!!seq" ]
        n="$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.paths | length' -)"
        [ "$n" -ge 1 ]
        [ "$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '[.paths[] | select(type != "!!str")] | length' -)" -eq 0 ]
    done
}

@test "RP-2 the globs are the ones the SDD names" {
    [ "$(globs "$RULES/stash-safety.md" | tr '\n' ' ')" = '**/*.sh **/*.bats .claude/scripts/** .claude/hooks/** ' ]
    [ "$(globs "$RULES/skill-invariants.md" | tr '\n' ' ')" = '.claude/skills/**/SKILL.md .claude/agents/** .claude/data/agent-types.yaml .claude/scripts/validate-skill-capabilities.sh ' ]
}

@test "RP-3 every stash-safety glob matches a tracked shell source" {
    local g hits
    while IFS= read -r g; do
        hits="$(tracked "$g" | grep -E '\.(sh|bats)$' | head -1)"
        [ -n "$hits" ] || { echo "glob '$g' matches no tracked .sh/.bats file"; return 1; }
    done < <(globs "$RULES/stash-safety.md")
}

@test "RP-4 every skill-invariants glob matches a tracked skill, agent definition or capability file" {
    local g hits
    while IFS= read -r g; do

    done < <(globs "$RULES/skill-invariants.md")
}

# counts and the volume ratio (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
#
#   kinds: mechanical N · judgment N · operator N
#   volume: script lines changed N (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed N (*.md) · model calls N (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: <path>
#
# Mapping (the glossary's "Kind counts" and "Volume ratio" entries):
#   kinds          the 'kind: <value>' token that ends each top-level '- [ ]' /
#                  '- [x]' task line under '### Technical Tasks', and each
#                  '- [ ] Task ...' line under a '### Task N.E2E' heading, inside
#                  a '## Sprint N' block of the sprint plan (fenced code skipped,
#                  the same scope validate-artifact.sh --type sprint enforces);
#                  untagged task lines are counted in --json and WARNed
#   script lines   added + deleted lines of *.sh *.py *.ts *.js files between
#                  the two commits (git diff --numstat, renames detected,
#                  binary files skipped)
#   prose bytes    bytes of the added and removed *.md lines between the two
#                  commits, newline included, diff markers excluded
#   model calls    MODELINV rows (primitive_id MODELINV) in the MODELINV log
#                  whose ts_utc lies between the two commits' committer
#                  timestamps, both ends included. The log is host-local, so
#                  the count covers only the calls made on this host: "scope:
#                  host". A missing log prints "model calls n/a" and a WARN.
#
# Git runs in the current directory's repository; --sprint-plan and --modelinv
# default to paths under its top level.
#
# Usage:
#   tools/cycle-ratio.sh --from SHA --to SHA [--sprint-plan PATH]
#                        [--modelinv PATH] [--json]
#
#   --sprint-plan PATH  default grimoires/loa/sprint.md
#   --modelinv PATH     default .run/model-invoke.jsonl
#   --json              one JSON object instead of the two lines
#
# Exit 2 also covers: not a git repository, an unreadable sprint plan, jq missing.
# Exit codes: 0 printed · 2 usage or unreadable input · 3 a SHA names no commit
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
die() { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

FROM=""
TO=""
PLAN=""
MODELINV=""
JSON=0
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --from|--to|--sprint-plan|--modelinv)
      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $1 needs a value" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
      case "$1" in
        --from) FROM="$2" ;;
        --to) TO="$2" ;;
        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
      esac
      shift 2 ;;
    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "cycle-ratio.sh: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 2 "jq is required"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "not inside a git repository"
[[ -n "$PLAN" ]] || PLAN="$TOP/grimoires/loa/sprint.md"
[[ -n "$MODELINV" ]] || MODELINV="$TOP/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"

case "$FROM" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM" ;; esac
case "$TO" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $TO" ;; esac
FROM_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${FROM}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM"

  md_fence($0) { next }

    next
  }

  sec == 2 && $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] Task / { next }
  {
    if (match($0, /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)[[:space:]]*$/)) {
      v = substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH)

      n[v]++
    } else n["untagged"]++
  }
  END { printf "%d %d %d %d\n", n["mechanical"], n["judgment"], n["operator"], n["untagged"] }
' "$PLAN")"
read -r K_MECH K_JUDG K_OPER K_UNTAGGED <<< "$kinds"
[[ "$K_UNTAGGED" -eq 0 ]] || echo "WARN: $K_UNTAGGED task line(s) in $PLAN carry no kind: tag and are not counted" >&2

# --- volume ------------------------------------------------------------------
GIT_DIFF=(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv -M)
SCRIPT_LINES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --numstat "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.ts' '*.js' \
  | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { s += $1 + $2 } END { printf "%d\n", s }')"
PROSE_BYTES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --unified=0 "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.md' \
  | awk '
      /^diff --git / { hunk = 0; next }
      /^@@ / { hunk = 1; next }
      # the marker byte stands in for the newline the diff line drops
      hunk && /^[+-]/ { s += length($0) }
      END { printf "%d\n", s }
    ')"

# --- model calls -------------------------------------------------------------
FROM_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$FROM_SHA")"
TO_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$TO_SHA")"
MODEL_CALLS=""
if [[ -f "$MODELINV" && -r "$MODELINV" ]]; then
  MODEL_CALLS="$(jq -R --argjson lo "$FROM_TS" --argjson hi "$TO_TS" '
      fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .primitive_id == "MODELINV")
      | (.ts_utc // "") | tostring

      | select(. != null and . >= $lo and . <= $hi)
    ' "$MODELINV" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
else
  echo "WARN: MODELINV log not found at $MODELINV; model calls n/a" >&2
fi

iso() { jq -nr --argjson t "$1" '$t | todateiso8601'; }

if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
  jq -n \
    --arg from "$FROM_SHA" --arg to "$TO_SHA" \
    --arg from_ts "$(iso "$FROM_TS")" --arg to_ts "$(iso "$TO_TS")" \
    --arg plan "$PLAN" --arg modelinv "$MODELINV" \
    --argjson mech "$K_MECH" --argjson judg "$K_JUDG" --argjson oper "$K_OPER" --argjson untagged "$K_UNTAGGED" \
    --argjson script_lines "$SCRIPT_LINES" --argjson prose_bytes "$PROSE_BYTES" \

      volume: {script_lines_changed: $script_lines, prose_bytes_changed: $prose_bytes,
               model_calls: (if $calls == "" then null else ($calls | tonumber) end),
               scope: "host", modelinv: $modelinv}}'
else
  printf 'kinds: mechanical %s · judgment %s · operator %s\n' "$K_MECH" "$K_JUDG" "$K_OPER"
  printf "volume: script lines changed %s (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed %s (*.md) · model calls %s (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: %s\n" \

2. Make executable: `chmod +x evals/graders/my-grader.sh`

3. **Important**: Do not use `source`, `eval`, or `.` with variable expansion — the trust boundary scanner will reject it in CI.

### Adding a New Fixture

1. Create directory in `evals/fixtures/<name>/`
2. Add `fixture.yaml` with metadata:
   ```yaml
   name: my-fixture
   description: "What this fixture represents"
   dependency_strategy: none  # none | prebaked | offline-cache
   ```
3. Add fixture files (source code, configs, etc.)
4. **Note**: If the fixture needs `.loa.config.yaml`, it will be tracked automatically (gitignore negation rule exists for `evals/fixtures/**/.loa.config.yaml`)

### Investigating a CI Failure

1. Check the PR comment for which suite/tasks failed
2. Download artifacts:
   ```bash
   gh run download <run-id> --name eval-results-<pr-number>
   ```
3. Read `run-meta.json` for summary, `comparison.json` for regression details
4. Read `task-<task-id>.jsonl` for per-grader output
5. Reproduce locally:
   ```bash
   ./evals/harness/run-eval.sh --task <task-id> --trusted --verbose
   ```

======
| Suite | Fixtures | Grader | Gate (arm B vs arm A) |
|-------|----------|--------|-----------------------|
| `review-recall` | `fixtures/review-prs/pr-01..10` (24 planted defects over 8 PRs, 2 clean) | `recall-vs-defects.sh`, `verdict-consistency.sh` | mean recall ≥ A − 0.1; false positives on clean PRs ≤ A |
| `audit-recall` | same corpus, `auditing-security` | same | recall gates + mean tokens per call ≤ 0.5 × A |
| `implement-discipline` | `fixtures/implement-tasks/01..05` | `implement-discipline.sh` (test-first, surgical, zone, tests-pass) | mean pass rate ≥ A |

The corpus is built from this repository's own `fix(...)` commits by `fixtures/build-review-corpus.sh`
(each defect PR turns fixed code back into the buggy parent; comment-only lines the fix added are
stripped so the diff removes code, never a confession) and frozen by `review-prs/SHA256SUMS`
(`build-review-corpus.sh --verify`). Hidden manifests (`review-prs/manifests/`, `implement-tasks/expectations/`)
are never copied into a sandbox. A defect counts as detected when the output cites the defect's file and
a line within ±3 of the manifest anchor — no fuzzy adjudication.

```bash
# arm A on the pre-change prompt tree (a worktree), arm B on the current tree, same model + effort
EVAL_PROMPT_TREE=/path/to/worktree EVAL_MODEL=claude-sonnet-5 EVAL_EFFORT=medium \
  ./evals/harness/run-eval.sh --suite review-recall --trusted --concurrency 2
./evals/harness/compare.sh --results <arm-a>/results.jsonl --suite review-recall --prompt-tree /path/to/worktree \
  --update-baseline --reason "arm A" --baseline-out evals/baselines/review-recall.baseline.yaml
./evals/harness/compare.sh --ab --arm-a <arm-a-run-dir> --arm-b <arm-b-run-dir> --metric recall
```

`compare.sh` refuses a baseline whose `prompt_tree_sha` equals the tree under comparison, whose
`captured_at_commit` is not a descendant of the suite's `ab.floor_commit`, or whose `corpus_sha256`
drifted (`evals/tests/recall-baseline-freshness.bats`). Tests: `evals/tests/{execute-agent,eval-recall-grader,implement-discipline-grader,recall-baseline-freshness}.bats`.

## Control arms and the record corpus (cycle-129 FR-2)

Each recall suite pre-registers control arms in `ab.arms` (review: `baseline`, `no_companion`
(informational), `no_karpathy`, `no_rule_files`; audit: `baseline`, `no_audit_delta`) and the verdict rule
in `ab.threshold`. `execute-agent.sh` applies an arm (`LOA_EVAL_ARM`) to the sandbox copy only, after
materialisation and immediately before the executor starts, and fails the trial (exit 2) when a toggle
cannot take effect; `executor.json` records `arm`, `arm_toggles`, `arm_evidence`, `source_commit`,
`models_used` and `refusal_fallbacks`. The executor never inherits the calling Claude Code session's
coupling, and its subagent model is pinned to `EVAL_MODEL`.

The record fixtures `pr-11` … `pr-18` are the round-1 states of sprints 247–254, built by
`harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh` from `review-prs/record-pairs.tsv` and the `record/cycle-12x-a2a`
branches. A feedback finding becomes a label only when the fix commit touches the file it cites. Labels
live in the hidden `review-prs/labels/pr-NN.tsv` (never in the sandbox-copied `pr-NN/`), every drop is
explained in `labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt`, and hand curation is the data file `labels/curation.tsv`,
re-applied on every seed. `fix` rows (the hunks the fix commit changed) feed the grader's refuted share
only. A label file is approved with `seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <date>"`;
`run-arms.sh` refuses unapproved fixtures unless `--allow-unapproved`.

```bash
# one suite, one batch, against a detached worktree pinned at the source commit
./evals/harness/run-arms.sh --suite review-recall --arms baseline,no_companion,no_karpathy,no_rule_files \
  --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,pr-03,pr-04,pr-05,pr-06,pr-07,pr-08 --trials 3 --source-commit 864069f2 --dry-run
./evals/harness/report.sh --arms            # refuses until STATUS.json is complete; --partial for interim
./evals/harness/compare.sh --ab --arm-a evals/results/arms/review-recall/<batch>/baseline \
  --arm-b evals/results/arms/review-recall/<batch>/no_karpathy --metric recall
```

Tests: `evals/tests/{arm-toggles,run-arms,arms-report,seed-corpus}.bats`.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# execute-agent.sh — agent-execution step for Loa Eval Sandbox trials
     4	#
     5	# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9 / SDD §3.6). Fills the slot at the top of the
     6	# grading step in run-eval.sh: a task that declares `.agent.skill` runs the
     7	# headless Claude CLI inside the sandbox before its graders; every other task
     8	# takes the pre-existing path untouched.
     9	#
    10	# What it does, in order:
    11	#   1. Gate: no `.agent.skill` in the task YAML → exit 3, nothing written.
    12	#   2. Materialize the prompt surface from $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE into the sandbox:
    13	#        <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/        (SKILL.md + resources/)
    14	#        <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md      (+ .claude/rules/)
    15	#        <ws>/CLAUDE.md                      → "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
    16	#        <ws>/.eval/skill-prompt.md          (SKILL.md body, frontmatter stripped)
    17	#      The prompt tree is the ONLY thing that differs between A/B arms, so it
    18	#      is recorded: prompt_tree_sha = `git rev-parse HEAD:.claude` of the tree,
    19	#      prompt_tree_commit, and whether .claude/ had uncommitted changes.
    20	#   3. Run:  claude -p "<task.prompt>" --output-format stream-json --verbose
    21	#              --model $EVAL_MODEL [--effort <e>] --restricted --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Write
    22	#              --permission-mode acceptEdits --append-system-prompt-file <skill-prompt>
    23	#              --max-turns $EVAL_MAX_TURNS
    24	#      --restricted --tools names the SDD's fixed tool set EXACTLY: it removes the
    25	#      code-running tools, ignores the operator's user/project/local settings (their
    26	#      Bash(...) allow rules leaked into the sprint-237 A/B arms under --allowed-tools,
    27	#      which only adds rules) and confines Read/Grep/Glob/Write to the sandbox.
    28	#      Edit/MultiEdit are therefore unavailable; the transcript extractor below still
    29	#      records them defensively.
    30	#      cwd = sandbox; env-isolated (LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH / LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and
    31	#      TMPDIR into the sandbox; GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/OPENAI_API_KEY/AWS_* unset;
    32	#      HOME and PATH stay so the CLI finds its own credentials and toolchain).
    33	#   4. Record <ws>/.eval/events.jsonl (raw stream), agent-output.json (the
    34	#      `result` event) and executor.json:
    35	#        {schema_version, skill, model_requested, model_id (the id the CLI
    36	#         echoed — the modelUsage entry with the most output tokens), effort,
    37	#         prompt_tree_sha, prompt_tree_commit, prompt_tree_dirty, exit_code,
    38	#         is_error, duration_ms, num_turns, total_cost_usd, usage{…},
    39	#         tool_writes:[{seq,tool,path}] in transcript order}
    40	#
    41	# Exit codes:
    42	#   0  agent ran (its own verdict is the graders' business)
    43	#   1  the CLI exited non-zero or timed out (executor.json still written)
    44	#   2  infrastructure error (CLI binary missing, prompt tree lacks the skill)
    45	#   3  task declares no agent (caller should not have called us)
    46	#
    47	# Env:
    48	#   EVAL_MODEL          model passed to --model            (default claude-sonnet-5)
    49	#   EVAL_EFFORT         override effort                    (default: task/skill)
    50	#   EVAL_PROMPT_TREE    repo whose .claude/ is materialized (default: this repo)
    60	#                         evals/suites/<task dir name>.yaml (`ab.arms[]`)
    61	#   LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT  recorded as source_commit (default: the prompt
    62	#                         tree's HEAD)
    63	#   Toggles are applied to the SANDBOX COPY only, after every materialisation
    64	#   step and immediately before the executor starts; each is verified absent
    65	#   afterwards and a toggle that cannot take effect is exit 2 (an arm never
    66	#   silently runs as its baseline):
    67	#     companion_voice: false         flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
    68	#                                    in <ws>/.loa.config.yaml (yq)
    69	#     karpathy_block: false          '## Karpathy Principles' section out of
    70	#                                    <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md; Karpathy rows
    71	#                                    out of <ws>/.claude/data/constraints.json if present
    72	#     rule_files: false              stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of <ws>/.claude/rules/
    73	#     audit_delta_instruction: false the paragraph containing "look for what the
    74	#                                    review did not", else "Confirm the review's demotions
    75	#                                    independently", out of the sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md
    76	#   The appended skill prompt (.eval/skill-prompt.md) is derived from the
    77	#   toggled sandbox SKILL.md. executor.json records arm, arm_toggles,
    78	#   arm_evidence and source_commit.

    88	WORKSPACE=""
    89	RUN_ID=""

    96	}

   101	    --workspace) WORKSPACE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   102	    --run-id) RUN_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   103	    --trial-id) TRIAL_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   104	    --timeout) TIMEOUT_S="$2"; shift 2 ;;
